prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 5 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1424; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a side-impact motor vehicle collision at an intersection with complaints of right knee pain, swelling, and reduced range of motion. Examination revealed a moderate effusion, tenderness along the medial joint line, and pain with valgus stress. Plain radiographs of the right knee showed no acute fracture or dislocation. Clinical findings were consistent with a soft tissue injury to the medial collateral ligament and meniscal irritation, with no evidence of instability on initial testing.

Over five visits, treatment consisted of rest, ice, compression, and a hinged knee brace for protection during ambulation. Anti-inflammatory medication was prescribed for pain and swelling, and a structured physical therapy program was initiated focusing on quadriceps strengthening, range-of-motion restoration, and gait training. Symptoms improved steadily, with effusion resolving and range of motion approaching the uninjured side by the final visit.

At the most recent evaluation, the patient reported mild residual discomfort with prolonged standing and stair descent but was able to perform daily activities and return to part-time work. Continued home exercise and activity modification were recommended, with follow-up as needed should symptoms worsen or fail to improve.
